hints.title: Evaluate Marginal Ratio Gain
hints.text: Adding an extra passing student to class (p, t) increases its ratio by (p + 1) / (t + 1) - p / t.

hints.title: Priority by Marginal Improvement
hints.text: Maintain classes in an ordered structure keyed by the gain from adding one student.

hints.title: Greedy Student Allocation
hints.text: For each extra student, extract class with highest marginal gain, increment its pass and total count, and reinsert.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: extraStudents is count of students to allocate
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating gains across all classes linearly takes O(extraStudents * n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Max-heap enables O(log n) student assignment and ratio update.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate derives marginal gain function delta(p, t) = (p + 1)/(t + 1) - p/t.

solutions.approach: Max-heap on marginal pass ratio improvement
